lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the dark torso. Spacing is irregular, with the widest interval located between the second and third anterior lines, and decreasing intervals toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple segments, specifically the 5th and 6th lines from the anterior, terminate at mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of approximately 3 distinct white spots located on the lower posterior haunch, adjacent to the start of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral, extending dorsolaterally from the frontal bone before recurving medially and upwards.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the terminal 12-15% of the total vertical horn structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white transverse chevron on the nasal bridge; two vertically aligned white spots on the lower cheek; distinct white markings on the lower limbs (socks) and ear margins.
